summary: The kit as a function: these inputs are everything a theme or a subtree can change; every length, color, type size and curve is derived from them by the resolvers. Ranges and defaults are not repeated here: each group names the export that owns them (the registry shows them on lookup), and a test keeps the member lists equal to those exports. constants lists the coefficients the formulas fix.
drivesMeaning: A drives edge (parameter → tokens, geometry or foundation) means the parameter enters that node's formulas; a component responds to a parameter when it uses a node the parameter drives.

unit.title: Unit u
unit.formula: every length is a multiple of u: control height 8u, padding 1u − B, icon slot 6u, control font 10px + u, type base 10px + u; [size] sets u per subtree

border.title: Border B
border.formula: whole px, clamped to 0..u/2; lives inside the padding (1u − B), so outer sizes never change

curvature.title: Curvature: radius scale s and corner shape k
curvature.formula: radius = min(3u × s, 4u) for controls (checkbox u × s, swatch u × s, tracks min(3u × s, 2u)); nested radii stay concentric (inner = outer − inset); corner-shape: superellipse(k) on every element with a radius (1 round, 2 squircle, 0 bevel, < 0 scoop)

container-curvature.title: Container radius magnitude t
container-curvature.formula: R = t × R0, t in 0..1: R0 is the family's concentric radius (group, collection: the control radius + p; card: p × min(1, s)); 1 keeps it concentric, 0 square, so a container can be sharper than fully rounded contents; the radius attribute sets t on one element

type-scale.title: Type scale: ratio r and rhythm
type-scale.formula: step role size = (10px + u) × r^step; line height rounds up to rhythm × u (0 keeps the natural height)

motion-global.title: Motion multipliers
motion-global.formula: every spring duration × motion-scale (0 is instant); every spring bounce × motion-bounce (0 is critically damped)

springs.title: Springs
springs.formula: a SwiftUI-style spring (perceptual duration, bounce) solved in CSS to a linear() easing and a settle duration

intents.title: Motion intents
intents.formula: which spring an intent runs: 0 quick, 1 smooth, 2 snappy, 3 bouncy; components animate by intent, never by spring

containers.title: Container ladder
containers.formula: padding and gap per container level in u; [gap] overrides one element. Radius by family: composite = the control radius, its options R − D; wrapper (group, collection) = the control radius + p (concentric, square at s = 0); card = p × min(1, s); areas square

spectrum.title: Spectrum color settings
spectrum.formula: the HCT engine generates every family's 12-step ramp per scheme from these settings (generateSpectrum); roles alias ramp steps (ROLE_STEPS); the build uses the snapshot defaults.json, the jig regenerates live

roles.title: Color roles
roles.formula: each role requests a family (resolveRoles picks the nearest generated hue); every role token is a step of that family (<role>.subtle 3, .border 7, .solid 9, .fg 11)

faces.title: Font faces
faces.formula: a face is a font stack; voices point at faces and type roles use voices

voices.title: Font voices
voices.formula: data-font-<voice>="<face>" repoints a voice for a subtree; display and heading drop to weight 400 on a serif face

subtree.title: Per-subtree inputs

attributes.size: size / data-size: u for the subtree (2 … 12)
attributes.radius: radius on ui-group, ui-collection, ui-card: the magnitude t of the concentric radius, 0 … 1 in 0.05 steps
attributes.icon-size: icon-size / data-icon-size: sm, md, lg, fill
attributes.gap: gap: container gap in u (0–8, 0.5 steps), that element only

subtree.formula: the same formulas, evaluated with a local input: [size] re-resolves every length under it, .dark every role

constants.name: text run edges
constants.value: 0.5u beside text, 1u beside a slot, 2u at a bare edge (resolveTextRun)

constants.name: choice box
constants.value: 5u (checkbox radius u × s; radio and switch round)

constants.name: ramp step meanings
constants.value: Radix 1–12: 1–2 backgrounds, 3–5 interactive, 6–8 borders, 9–10 solids, 11–12 text
